anglesweetspotpercent.text: Colloquially, a player who hits the ball solidly is said to have gotten the "sweet spot" of the bat on the ball.

arm_strength.text: On an individual play, Arm Strength is defined as the maximum velocity of any throw made by a fielder -- with the max velocity always being at the release point, due to physics.

attack_angle.text: Attack angle measures the vertical direction that the sweet spot of the bat is traveling at the moment it hits the baseball.

attack_direction.text: Attack direction measures the horizontal direction that the sweet spot of the bat is moving at the point of contact with the baseball (or the point the bat and ball cross paths on a swing-and-miss).

barrels.text: The Barrel classification is assigned to batted-ball events whose comparable hit types (in terms of exit velocity and launch angle) have led to a minimum .500 batting average and 1.500 slugging percentage since Statcast was implemented Major League wide in 2015.

bolts.text: A Bolt is any run where the Sprint Speed (defined as "feet per second in a player's fastest one-second window") of the runner is at least 30 ft/sec.

hard_hit_percent.text: Statcast defines a 'hard-hit ball' as one hit with an exit velocity of 95 mph or higher, and a player's "hard-hit rate" is simply showing the percentage of batted balls that were hit at 95 mph or more.

oaa.text: Outs Above Average (OAA) is a range-based metric of skill that shows how many outs a player has saved.

spin_rate.text: Spin Rate measures the spin on the baseball when the pitch is released.

sprint_speed.text: Introduced during the 2017 season, Sprint Speed is a Statcast metric that aims to more precisely quantify speed by measuring how many feet per second a player runs in his fastest one-second window.

squared_up_rate.text: A swing’s squared-up rate tells us how much of the highest possible exit velocity available (based on the physics related to the swing speed and pitch speed) a batter was able to obtain – it is, at its simplest, how much exit velocity did you get as a share of how much exit velocity was possible based on your swing speed and the speed of the pitch.

swing_length.text: Swing length is a metric intended to identify if a batter has a short or long swing.

swing_tilt.text: Swing path is a metric that tells you the shape of a hitter's swing on the way toward contact.

xba.text: Expected Batting Average (xBA) is a Statcast metric that measures the likelihood that a batted ball will become a hit.

xera.text: Expected ERA, or xERA, is a simple 1:1 translation of Expected Weighted On-Base Average (xwOBA), converted to the ERA scale. xwOBA takes into account the amount of contact (strikeouts, walks, hit by pitch) and the quality of that contact (exit velocity and launch angle), in an attempt to credit the pitcher or hitter for the moment of contact, not for what might happen to that contact thanks to other factors like ballpark, weather, or defense.

xslg.text: Expected Slugging Percentage (xSLG) is formulated using exit velocity, launch angle and, on certain types of batted balls, Sprint Speed.

xwoba.text: Expected Weighted On-base Average (xwOBA) is formulated using exit velocity, launch angle and, on certain types of batted balls, Sprint Speed.

api_break_x_arm.text: Break, in inches, of a pitch to the pitcher's arm side.

api_break_x_batter_in.text: Break, in inches, of a pitch toward the batter's side of plate.

arm_angle.text: The angle between a line parallel to the ground and a l line extending from the location of the pitcher's throwing shoulder and the location of the ball at the time of the pitch.

at_bat_number.text: Plate appearance number of the game.

attack_angle.text: Attack Angle measures the vertical angle of the direction in which the sweet spot of the bat is traveling as it impacts the ball, as compared to the ground.

attack_direction.text: Attack Direction measures the horizontal angle of the direction in which the sweet spot of the bat is traveling as it impacts the ball, as compared to a line from home plate to straightaway center field.

ax.text: The acceleration of the pitch, in feet per second per second, in x-dimension, determined at y=50 feet.

ay.text: The acceleration of the pitch, in feet per second per second, in y-dimension, determined at y=50 feet.

az.text: The acceleration of the pitch, in feet per second per second, in z-dimension, determined at y=50 feet.

babip_value.text: BABIP value based on result of play.

balls.text: Pre-pitch number of balls in count.

bat_score_diff.text: Batting team score less Pitching team score

batter.text: MLB Player Id tied to the play event.

batter_days_since_prev_game.text: number of days since batter's last game

batter_days_until_next_game.text: number of days until the batter's next game

bb_type.text: Batted ball type, ground_ball, line_drive, fly_ball, popup.

break_angle_deprecated.text: * Deprecated field from the old tracking system.

break_length_deprecated.text: * Deprecated field from the old tracking system.

delta_home_win_exp.text: The change in Win Expectancy before the Plate Appearance and after the Plate Appearance

delta_run_exp.text: The change in Run Expectancy before the Pitch and after the Pitch

des.text: Plate appearance description from game day.

effective_speed.text: Derived speed based on the the extension of the pitcher's release.

estimated_ba_using_speedangle.text: Estimated Batting Avg based on launch angle and exit velocity.

estimated_woba_using_speedangle.text: Estimated wOBA based on launch angle and exit velocity.

events.text: Event of the resulting Plate Appearance.

fielder_2.text: Pre-pitch MLB Player Id of Catcher.

game_type.text: Type of Game. E = Exhibition, S = Spring Training, R = Regular Season, F = Wild Card, D = Divisional Series, L = League Championship Series, W = World Series

hc_x.text: Hit coordinate X of batted ball.

hc_y.text: Hit coordinate Y of batted ball.

hit_location.text: Position of first fielder to touch the ball.

hyper_speed.text: Savant display name: Adjusted EV. Adjusted Exit Velocity sets every batted ball hit below 88 mph as 88 mph, otherwise it uses the actual Exit Velocity

if_fielding_alignment.text: Infield fielding alignment at the time of the pitch.

inning_topbot.text: Pre-pitch top or bottom of inning.

intercept_ball_minus_batter_pos_x_inches.text: Distance, in inches, between the intercept point of the bat/ball and the batter's center of mass, in the X (horizontal) direction.

intercept_ball_minus_batter_pos_y_inches.text: Distance, in inches, between the intercept point of the bat/ball and the batter's center of mass, in the Y (mound-to-plate) direction.

iso_value.text: ISO value based on result of play.

launch_angle.text: Launch angle of the batted ball as tracked by Statcast. For the limited subset of batted balls not tracked directly, estimates are included based on the process described here .

launch_speed.text: Exit velocity of the batted ball as tracked by Statcast. For the limited subset of batted balls not tracked directly, estimates are included based on the process described here .

launch_speed_angle.text: Launch speed/angle zone based on launch angle and exit velocity. Weak Topped Under Flare/Burner Solid Contact Barrel

n_priorpa_thisgame_player_at_bat.text: number of prior PAs in this game for this batter

of_fielding_alignment.text: Outfield fielding alignment at the time of the pitch.

on_1b.text: Pre-pitch MLB Player Id of Runner on 1B.

on_2b.text: Pre-pitch MLB Player Id of Runner on 2B.

on_3b.text: Pre-pitch MLB Player Id of Runner on 3B.

pfx_x.text: Horizontal movement in feet from the catcher's perspective.

pfx_z.text: Vertical movement in feet from the catcher's perpsective.

pitch_number.text: Total pitch number of the plate appearance.

pitch_type.text: The type of pitch derived from Statcast.

pitcher.text: MLB Player Id tied to the play event.

pitcher_days_until_next_game.text: number of days until the pitcher's next game

plate_z.text: Vertical position of the ball when it crosses home plate from the catcher's perspective. Through 2025, this was front-of-plate. From 2026 on, this is middle-of-plate to align with the ABS system.

release_extension.text: Release extension of pitch in feet as tracked by Statcast.

release_pos_y.text: Release position of pitch measured in feet from the catcher's perspective.

release_pos_z.text: Vertical Release Position of the ball measured in feet from the catcher's perspective.

release_speed.text: Pitch velocity in MPH. Values from 2008-16 are via PitchFX, and adjusted to roughly out-of-hand release point. All velocities from 2017 and beyond are Statcast, which are reported out-of-hand. All velocities are thus on the same scale.

spin_axis.text: The Spin Axis in the 2D X-Z plane in degrees from 0 to 360, such that 180 represents a pure backspin fastball and 0 degrees represents a pure topspin (12-6) curveball

strikes.text: Pre-pitch number of strikes in count.

sv_id.text: Non-unique Id of play event per game.

swing_path_tilt.text: The vertical angular orientation of the "plane" of the swing, as compared to the ground, defined by the path of the bat in the 40 ms prior to contact, which approximates a slice of a flat disc in shape.
